faqItems.question: Do you accept my dental insurance?
faqItems.answer: Angell Family Dentistry is in-network with all major insurance providers. We will even submit all forms for you to help you maximize your benefits.

faqItems.question: Can I get a crown in one day?
faqItems.answer: Yes! Our same-day crown technology allows us to design, create, and place your permanent crown in just one visit, eliminating the need for temporaries.

faqItems.question: What payment options do you offer?
faqItems.answer: We accept cash, checks, and all major credit cards. We also offer flexible monthly and bi-weekly payment plans with low down payments.

faqItems.question: Are you accepting new patients?
faqItems.answer: We are currently welcoming new patients of all ages! We even prioritize emergency calls to see new patients the same day whenever possible.

faqItems.question: Is your office family-friendly?
faqItems.answer: Absolutely. From a child's first tooth to senior dental care, we provide gentle pediatric dentistry and services for patients of all ages.

faqItems.question: Where is your office located?
faqItems.answer: We are located at 423 40th Ave NE #3719, serving families in Columbia Heights, Minneapolis, and the surrounding MN communities.

clinic.footerAbout: Angell Family Dentistry provides trusted dental care for the Columbia Heights community, specializing in family, cosmetic, and restorative treatments since 2008.

doctor.name: Steven Angell
doctor.bio: Dr. Steven Angell has been providing comprehensive dental care at Angell Family Dentistry since 2008. He earned his undergraduate degree from St. John’s University and his dental degree from the University of Minnesota. An active member of the Minnesota and American Dental Associations, he is dedicated to all areas of family dentistry. Dr. Angell stays current with advanced techniques through the OMS Study Club and is committed to serving the community through Give Kids a Smile.
